newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia July 1-15 palm oil exports 307,536t - SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia July 1-15 palm oil exports 307,536t - SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd on Tuesday said it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for July 1-15 at 307,536 tonnes against 290,935 tonnes for June 1-15.
It said the exports comprised 82,765 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 146,095 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 39,550 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products totalled 39,126 tonnes.
India was the top buyer during the period, taking 56,381 tonnes, followed by China which bought 56,350 tonnes, Egypt (36,795 tonnes) and Pakistan (35,350 tonnes).
Countries in the European Union bought 43,250 tonnes. -- Tan Lee Lee - Kuala Lumpur newsroom (603-275-6834)
